_comment: Chinese string literals that must NOT be translated, and are therefore
excluded from the localization coverage gate.
These are never shown to a user as a label. Translating them would change
what the code does, so each entry names why it is exempt. Add to this list
only when a literal is machine-readable data that happens to contain
Chinese, never to make the gate quieter about a real UI string.

entries.reason: Redaction regex in WindowsDiagnosticLog. The Chinese words are alternation branches that match key names in captured JSON; rewriting them would stop passwords and verification codes from being redacted.
Redaction regex in WindowsDiagnosticLog for key=value text. Same reason as above.

entries.value: Controlled Windows diagnostic fault; token=diagnostic-secret-token; 房间密码：diagnostic-room-password
entries.reason: Fault injected on purpose in Program.cs to prove the diagnostic log redacts a token and a room password. The redaction patterns are matched against this exact text, so a translation would invalidate the check it exists for.
